overview_description.description: Zaymo is a software company that offers interactive email solutions for e-commerce stores. Their services include a no-code email builder designed to reduce friction in emails and enhance customer experience. They also provide features such as 'Shop in Email' to boost revenue from abandoned carts, email newsletters, and drip campaigns. Additionally, Zaymo offers a 'Review Capture' service that aims to capture 3x more reviews. Their commitment to privacy is evident in their data collection and usage policies.
